gaps.lead: This is the worst traffic I've ever experienced.
gaps.explanation: Never before + have + subject + participle: Never have I experienced.

gaps.lead: The film was so long that we missed the last bus.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that we missed the last bus.
gaps.explanation: so long (a film) → such a long film.

gaps.lead: We got to the airport late and missed the flight.
gaps.sentence: If we had got to the airport earlier, we ___ the flight.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + participle.

gaps.lead: I only understood the joke much later.
gaps.explanation: After 'only + time phrase' at the front, invert: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say → It is said… / The castle is said to be…

gaps.lead: It took me two hours to assemble the wardrobe.
gaps.sentence: I ___ two hours assembling the wardrobe.
gaps.explanation: it took + time + to do = subject + spent + time + -ing.
